name: Dmr Unlu Mamuller Uretim Gida Toptan Perakende Ihracat A.S.
summary: Dmr Unlu Mamuller Uretim Gida Toptan Perakende Ihracat A.S., together with its subsidiaries, produces, wholesales, and retail bakery products under the Simit Sarayi brand in Turkey and internationally. The company offers pastries, bread rolls, sandwiches, pizzas, pies, croissants, cakes, pastries, sipits, soft bagels, buns, boreks, cookies, bread, and wraps; and raw cooked and cooked frozen bagels. It also provides personnel support services. The company sells its products to hotels, restaurants, cafes, and supermarkets through its stores.
